bio: Close to rapper Lil Jay of STL/EBT. Member of FBG.
Best friend of Duskie. Was very close to Hadi. Very close to Wooski of STL/EBT.
After his death, E-Block adopted the name HadiWay.
Killed Taedoe, who was his friend. Triggered the war against Lowelife.
A very good rapper. Close to Prince Dre of O'Block.
Despite their rival sets, he and King Von were very close in prison. Very good friend of FBG Wooski of STL/EBT. Won his murder trial in 2019.
Now a comedian. Was a rapper who didn't hesitate to diss his dead enemies. Had personal beef with Lil John of Lowelife. Fought with Lil John.
Snitched on C-Money of Buff City for Willie's murder.
Robbed Ballout of Lamron. Along with Welch World members, robbed GBE Capo of Front$treet. Robbed Lil Varney of Lamron. Was close to MuBu Krump and is still close to Tay600.

Had personal beef with L'A Capone of 600 before he died. Fought Jusblow of 600 and was winning until someone passed Jusblow a chair. Made O'Block Ocho run and Ocho said he wasn't a BD so Nez wouldn't kill him. Snatched the OTF600 chain from Memo600 in 2019.

Dedicated by Chief Keef multiple times. Very close to Dart of ABM and Fredo Santana of Front$treet. Friends with many respected Black Disciples across Chicago. Participated with TYMB Face in kidnapping and killing OJ of Jaro City and Lil D of MetBoyz. Known for killing rapper Lil Jojo of Brick$quad 069. Was heavily followed by the FBI for a time.
Was very close to L'A Capone of 600. Left Chicago after being pressured by E-Block members and Melly of 051 Young Money.
Also represents No Luv City. Was close to Poppie and TB of Tyquan World. Set up Cheno of O'Block for Poppie to kill him.
Close to Zo of No Luv City.
